name: Underdog Saluki 27B

based_on.note: A 2-bit (IQ2-mix) Qwen3.8-27B tuned by Underdog to keep tool calling, built from ISTA-DASLab's GSQ-RCO GGUF. Underdog's own benchmark: 96% average retention across 9 benchmarks.

architecture.layer_mix: 48 linear (Gated DeltaNet) + 16 full attention, every 4th layer full

summary: Underdog's tool-calling-tuned 2-bit Qwen3.8-27B: one 7.9 GB GGUF for stock llama.cpp, aimed at 12 GB GPUs.

practical_baseline.reason: Only sub-4-bit builds exist for this model, so the directory's 4-bit-or-better baseline policy cannot select one. Pick by your hardware.
